import pygame, random, sys

# ----- Config -----
WIDTH, HEIGHT = 480, 800
FPS = 60
GRAVITY = 1500   # pixels/s^2
JUMP_VELOCITY = -350  # pixels/s
BASE_SCROLL_SPEED = 120  # initial speed of platforms (pixels/s)
SCROLL_ACCEL = 200       # extra acceleration per second

# Colors
def random_color():
    return tuple(random.randint(80, 255) for _ in range(3))

# ----- Helper classes -----
class Particle:
    def __init__(self,x,y,radius,color):
        self.x=x; self.y=y; self.radius=radius; self.color=color
        self.age=0

    def update(self):
        self.age+=1
        return self.age < 30   # live 30 frames (~0.5s)

    @staticmethod
    def draw(surf, part):
        alpha = max(0, 255 - part.age*8)
        if alpha <= 0:
            return False
        tmp = pygame.Surface((part.radius*2, part.radius*2), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        pygame.draw.circle(tmp, (*part.color, alpha), (part.radius, part.radius), part.radius)
        surf.blit(tmp,(int(part.x-part.radius), int(part.y-part.radius)))
        return True

# ----- Game functions -----
def make_gradient():
    surf = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
    for y in range(HEIGHT):
        ratio = y / HEIGHT
        r = int(10 + (5-10)*ratio)
        g = int(10 + (5-10)*ratio)
        b = int(30 + (15-30)*ratio)
        pygame.draw.line(surf, (r,g,b), (0,y),(WIDTH-1,y))
    return surf

def spawn_platform():
    w = random.randint(80, 140)
    x = random.randint(0, WIDTH-w)
    col = random_color()
    y = -random.randint(HEIGHT, HEIGHT*3)
    return {'rect': pygame.Rect(x,y,w,20), 'col': col}

def draw_text(surface, text, size, color, y):
    font = pygame.font.SysFont(None, size)
    txt = font.render(text, True, color)
    rect = txt.get_rect(center=(WIDTH//2, y))
    surface.blit(txt, rect)

# ----- Main -----
def main():
    pygame.init()
    clock = pygame.time.Clock()
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
    gradient_surf = make_gradient()

    particles = []
    platforms = [spawn_platform() for _ in range(5)]
    for p in platforms:
        p['rect'].y = random.randint(-HEIGHT*2, -100)

    player = pygame.Rect(WIDTH//2-15, HEIGHT-150, 30, 50)
    vy = 0.0
    on_ground = False
    score = 0
    combo = 0

    scroll_timer = 0.0

    while True:
        dt = clock.tick(FPS) / 1000.0
        scroll_timer += dt

        # Platform spawning/recycling
        if not platforms or platforms[-1]['rect'].top > HEIGHT*3:
            p = spawn_platform()
            p['rect'].y = -random.randint(HEIGHT, HEIGHT*2)
            platforms.append(p)

        # Move platforms downwards (speed increases)
        for plat in list(platforms):
            current_speed = BASE_SCROLL_SPEED + SCROLL_ACCEL * scroll_timer
            plat['rect'].y += current_speed * dt
            if plat['rect'].top > HEIGHT*3:
                platforms.remove(plat)
                newp = spawn_platform()
                newp['rect'].y = -random.randint(HEIGHT, HEIGHT*2)
                platforms.append(newp)

        # Input & physics
        for ev in pygame.event.get():
            if ev.type == pygame.QUIT:
                pygame.quit(); sys.exit()
            if ev.type == pygame.KEYDOWN and ev.key == pygame.K_SPACE and not on_ground:
                vy = JUMP_VELOCITY

        # Gravity
        vy += GRAVITY * dt
        player.y += vy

        # Landing detection
        landed = False
        for plat in platforms[:]:
            if (player.colliderect(plat['rect']) and vy > 0):
                player.bottom = plat['rect'].top
                vy = 0.0
                on_ground = True
                score += 10 * (combo if combo else 1)
                combo += 1
                for _ in range(12):
                    radius = random.randint(2,5)
                    particles.append(Particle(player.centerx,
                                             player.bottom - radius,
                                             radius,
                                             plat['col']))
                break
        if not landed:
            on_ground = False

        # Update particles
        for pt in particles[:]:
            if not pt.update():
                particles.remove(pt)

        # Game over condition: fell too far down
        if player.top > HEIGHT*2:
            pygame.quit(); sys.exit()

        # Drawing
        screen.blit(gradient_surf, (0,0))

        # Draw platforms with glow
        for plat in platforms:
            col = plat['col']
            pygame.draw.rect(screen, (*col, 200), plat['rect'])
            glow_rect = plat['rect'].copy()
            glow_rect.inflate_ip(6,6)
            glow_surf = pygame.Surface(glow_rect.size, pygame.SRCALPHA)
            glow_surf.fill((*col, 80))
            screen.blit(glow_surf, glow_rect.topleft)

        # Draw particles
        for pt in particles:
            Particle.draw(screen, pt)

        # Player
        pygame.draw.rect(screen, (255,200,0), player)

        # HUD
        draw_text(screen, f"Score: {score}", 24, (255,255,255), 10)
        draw_text(screen, f"Combo: x{combo}", 20, (200,255,200), 40)

        pygame.display.flip()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
